## 🎯 Purpose

In dbt, Silver is 'Intermediate'.
Reads from Bronze (Staging).

---

## 📐 Code Pattern (Extracted from v3.9)

```python
-- SILVER LAYER (Intermediate/Cleansed)
-- Generated by Legacy2Lake Architect Agent
-- Reference: {...}

{{
  config(
    materialized='incremental',
    unique_key=[{...}]
  )
}}

with bronze as (
    select * from {{ ref('{...}') }}
),

deduplicated as (
    -- Window function deduplication (efficient & keeps latest record)
    select * from (
        select 
            *,
            row_number() over (
                partition by {...}
                order by _ingested_at desc
            ) as _rn
        from bronze
    ) with_rn
    where _rn = 1
)

select * from deduplicated

-- Incremental logic
{% if is_incremental() %}
  -- this filter will only be applied on an incremental run
  where _ingested_at > (select max(_ingested_at) from {{ this }})
{% endif %}
```
